scope: Driver-operated Formula SAE electric vehicle and the team processes needed to compete

rule_ledger.native_chapter: source_rule_id or source_section_id for unnumbered objects
rule_ledger.native_text: short_paraphrase only after grounded semantic review; initially null
rule_ledger.structured_attribute_encoding: Arrays and objects are canonical JSON stored as native StringValueAttributes
rule_ledger.not_applicable_policy: Keep every IC-only clause and any other excluded clause with a reviewed source-grounded reason; never discard it
rule_ledger.conditional_policy: Keep the condition, controlling decision and unresolved status until the design determines applicability

native_requirements.types: CapellaTypesFolder contained in the same architecture.ownedExtensions
native_requirements.rule: Requirement with stable ReqIFIdentifier; source rule ID is not an integer ReqIFForeignID
native_requirements.satisfaction: CapellaOutgoingRelation, source=Capella design element, target=Requirement; owned by source.ownedExtensions; RelationType=satisfy
native_requirements.verification: CapellaIncomingRelation, source=Requirement, target=Capella Constraint; owned by requirement.ownedRelations; RelationType=verify
native_requirements.derivation: InternalRelation, source=derived Requirement, target=source Requirement; owned by derived requirement.ownedRelations; RelationType=derive

OA.system_context: Vehicle entity and human operational actors

SA.system_context: One black-box Electric Vehicle system; external SystemActors in SystemComponentPkg
SA.allocations: Black-box system or external actor to system function
SA.exchanges: FunctionalExchange via typed function ports; ComponentExchange via typed component ports
SA.containment_guard: Never decompose the non-actor SystemComponent or put Parts under it

LA.system_context: Subsystem LogicalComponents under logical system, LogicalActors in component package
LA.realizations: LogicalFunction to SystemFunction; logical system to SA system; logical actors to SA actors

PA.system_context: BEHAVIOR PhysicalComponents for functions and NODE PhysicalComponents for equipment
PA.realizations: PhysicalFunction to LogicalFunction; behavior PhysicalComponent to LogicalComponent; actor to logical actor
PA.deployment: Typed native part deployment links from behavior Parts to node Parts; no guessed deployment references
PA.parameters: Only exact source facts or explicitly unresolved engineering decisions; no invented ratings

EPBS.system_context: ConfigurationItem hierarchy below product/system configuration item
EPBS.realizations: ConfigurationItem to PA PhysicalComponent using PhysicalArtifactRealization
EPBS.identifiers: Stable model CI identifiers; manufacturer part numbers remain unresolved

engineering_decisions.question: Tube frame monocoque or other allowed structure?
Cell chemistry cell model series parallel configuration and exact ratings?
Motor inverter driveline topology and manufacturer specifications?
Brake circuit layout braking hardware and validated performance?
Charger equipment location charging limits and protection implementation?
Cooling strategy and worst-case thermal design?
Control hardware software architecture and independent safety implementation?
Any pressurized pneumatic or hydraulic equipment triggering T.6?
Driverless equipment outside the requested driver-operated baseline?

completion_gates: All normalized clauses and unnumbered source objects have exactly one persisted source Requirement
All source PDF body lines accounted for; every figure table formula and official referenced document reviewed
All applicability conditions reviewed; excluded items retain explicit grounded reasons
Every applicable normative clause has an interpreted obligation appropriate design or process owner and verification obligation
Technical design obligations have appropriate OA SA LA PA EPBS realization paths and native satisfaction relations
Process obligations trace to operational procedures roles and competition evidence rather than invented vehicle hardware
All engineering decisions resolved or approved as explicit bounded assumptions; no guessed numerical limits
Native validation has zero errors; every remaining warning has a reviewed justification
No dangling persistent references; all requirement links survive save close and reopen
All five perspectives have useful native diagrams showing the generated architecture
Chatbot create edit undo redo delete and save/reopen acceptance tests pass on the generated project
Model coverage and physical vehicle compliance are reported separately; verification_status is never automatically passed
